```{r setup}
library(jovanovic2025)
```



dump the output of all the models that are relevant for the package. This is meant to be used as a reference and not to be read from top to bottom.


```{r}
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| output: false
#| message: false
TreMs <- clean_data(MasterThesisData2024)
mod_df <- create_models(TreMs)
```


```{r}
#| results: asis
src <- mod_df |> dplyr::select(variable, model_family) |> purrr::pmap(\(variable, model_family) {
  knitr::knit_expand(
    here::here('vignettes/child/model_template.Rmd'), variable = variable, model_family = model_family
  )
})
res <- knitr::knit_child(text = unlist(src), quiet = TRUE)
cat(res, sep = '\n')
```
